title.rendered: Budget Committee Vacancies – Now Accepting Applications

content.rendered:
Sherwood School District Budget Committee positions #1 and #4 are open due to the expiration of the terms of Nicole Brutosky and Ryan Dunlap. The Board is currently seeking qualified applicants to fill these vacancies. The applicant selected will serve on the Budget Committee for a three-year term, beginning October 18, 2023 through June 30, 2026.

The Budget Committee plays a vital role in assisting the District and the community in reviewing the proposed budget each year before the proposal is presented to the Board for adoption. The Board invites interested community members to submit an application to be considered for appointment to the Budget Committee. Applications should be submitted to Christine Andregg, at the Sherwood School District Office, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd, Sherwood, OR 97140, or by email to candregg@sherwood.k12.or.us, by 4:00 p.m. on October 11, 2023. Please click the link below to download a fillable PDF version of the application.
